title: ARCADE RAID: ENDLESS, RANDOM KIT
why: His order of 2026-10-11, the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, build 2 of 20. An arcade raid is now possible (nothing on the title opens it yet): it is a normal raid built the normal way, then made endless. There is no raid clock, no extraction point ever closes, the extraction call takes 15 seconds, the peddler and the stray are left out, and every drop comes with a random loadout: a strong gun in hand and a different one on the back, a full magazine each and six more for the gun in hand, 3 Bandages, a Medkit, a Frag, a Smoke and full armour. It all plays on the sandbox profile, so nothing is saved and no run is counted, and leaving the arcade puts his profile and his settings back. A normal raid is exactly as it was.
now: Groundwork for the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO: an arcade raid has no clock, every extraction stays open, and every drop comes with a random loadout.
